summary: Suzhou suits slower, detail-rich travel centered on classical gardens, canal-side streets, elegant Jiangnan atmosphere, and low-pressure walking routes.
transport_notes: Suzhou is best experienced by clustering one garden area with one nearby canal street or old-town zone per day.
Central Suzhou works well with metro plus walking, but garden-heavy days should stay light on extra transfers.
Evening pacing is strongest in canal districts with food and slower pedestrian movement.

budget_notes.low: Use public canal walks, one signature old street, and simple local dining with easy walking access.
budget_notes.medium: Blend one garden, one canal district, and one atmospheric food area each day.
budget_notes.high: Add quieter boutique districts, slower tea or dining breaks, and more comfort-oriented pacing.

trip_type_notes.student: Student plans in Suzhou should emphasize scenic walking, photogenic old streets, and accessible Jiangnan food.
trip_type_notes.solo: Solo plans should feel calm, reflective, and rooted in canal-side wandering and garden detail.
trip_type_notes.couple: Couple plans should emphasize elegant scenery, water-town atmosphere, and soft evening light.
trip_type_notes.family: Family plans should keep distances short and focus on gardens, easier canals, and low-stress shared strolling.
